The integer equity table in ../../data/equity169.bin is from the same commit.
The complete table is locally regenerated and compared byte for byte by
../../tools/regenerate.sh. Poker Lab's JS evaluator cross-checks selected
class-pair totals; its CFR+ solver and independent SciPy LP do not use the
vendor solver's strategy output. gen_pushfold.cpp is retained for reference.
